extracted.name: Chicken kathi roll
extracted.description: #ldcarvings1 #street_food #week_1 #mommasrecipe #my_cookbook #cookpad #Post_5 Whenever we want to eat something yummy street food we always make this mommas recipe and eat during our evening snacks with some tangy and spicy chutneys..
ingredient_lines: 1 1/2 cup all purpose flour or maida
500 gm Chicken (boneless thigh cut into small pieces)
instruction_lines: First make a dough for paratha. For this in a large bowl put flour,salt,sugar,oil mix it well then slowly add water & knead a very soft dough set it for 20 minutes. Cover that bowl with a lid after few minutes open the lid and put the chicken pieces in a greased baking tray.

In a meanwhile marinate the chicken with yogurt,ginger garlic paste and other spices that mentioned above. Now make a whole at the center of the bowl put hot charcoal at the center then pour some oil over it then immediately.

Cover that bowl with a lid after few minutes open the lid and put the chicken pieces in a greased baking and put it in the preheated oven for about 15 to 20 minutes at highest temperature or you can simply roast it on the gas stove.

Now from the dough take a small portion of the dough then make a laccha paratha out of this(i.e firstmake a plain paratha then sprinkle with some oil and flour over it then with a knife cut at one side then starts folding then it becomes a cone then press it with hand)

Now assemble everything,first take a paratha put few chicken pieces followed by some onions, green chilies and other sauces chaat masala,lemon juice that mentioned above then roll it and cover half of the roll with butter paper & it’s done.. enjoy😊
